name: box_in_ascii
why: The same part in ASCII: the same twelve triangles, counted in another way -- «facet» lines instead of the four bytes of the header. Two roads to the same number, and if one of the two went wrong it would be seen at once.
_why_there_are_no_bytes: the size of an ASCII STL depends on how the float is written, and an expectation on it would be an expectation on the formatter of SOLIDWORKS, not on the part.

expect._why_twelve: the same twelve as the binary case: it is the part, not the format
